verdict.rationale: Fastmail's use of open, documented standards (JMAP, IMAP-compatible access) and its 'Open source and standards' page support data portability in principle, and JMAP autodiscovery is verified to work keylessly at runtime. However, the evidence pack only documents *importing* mail into Fastmail, not an explicit bulk data-export feature, and calendar/contacts export tools aren't mentioned. Missing for 10: documented full-account export tool/feature, explicit mention of exporting calendar/contacts in open formats, independent confirmation of a smooth export-and-leave experience.
